CHAPTER 14 · ITEM 03 / 12

Costs, revenue and profit

Marginal cost from total cost從總成本求邊際成本

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Apply marginal decisions using the change in total cost, including when average cost changes between output levels; average cost itself is not the cost of one extra unit.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

先把平均成本乘產量還原總成本，再用 ΔTC/ΔQ。額外單位成本可遠高於平均成本或平均成本增幅。

First convert average costs back to total costs when necessary, then take ΔTC/ΔQ. The extra unit's cost can be much larger than either the average cost or the change in average cost.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：Q=600,ATC=300 gives TC=180,000; Q=601,ATC=301 gives TC=180,901. The extra unit costs 901.

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Q=10,ATC=5; Q=11,ATC=6. MC of unit 11? 第十一件 MC？
